description: Connect a signal on a source node to a method on a target node, persisting it in the .tscn. Use get_node_signals first to confirm names - connecting the same pair twice creates a duplicate connection. Saves automatically. Returns a plain-text confirmation naming source, signal, target, and method. Errors if the signal or method does not exist. Errors while a Godot runtime session is active on this project; stop_project (or detach_project) clears it.

method.description: Method name on the target node to call when the signal fires

nodePath.description: Source node path from scene root

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

signal.description: Signal name on the source node (e.g. "pressed", "body_entered")

targetNodePath.description: Target node path from scene root that receives the signal

name: connect_signal
